expected_reason: Additive optional field: this `conformance-v1` record carries the optional `evaluator_identity`, the optional top-level `implementer_identity` and the optional evidence-entry `head`. A v1 reader that does not know these fields ignores them and reads every required field of the record identically — the same outcome, the same six marks and the same required evidence with or without them, and the outcome stays `accept` when any or all of the optional fields are removed, because the absence of an optional field never rejects a v1 record on its own (D2 l.269: the independent-review mark is resolved against the producer's identity record). A reader that knows the fields uses them instead of inferring: the recorded reviewer identity establishes the independent-review route, the recorded implementer identity makes the family comparison self-checking (D2 l.262–l.269), and the recorded evidence head is compared with the record's head (SDP l.543). This is a common-reader fixture, not silent parser leniency (representation rule, SDP l.536).
